description: Delete every message in a thread. Default soft-deletes to Trash; permanent:true expunges. acrossFolders:false by default for safety. dryRun:true previews.

acrossFolders.description: When false (default), act only within the seed message's folder. When true, walk INBOX + Sent + All Mail so the whole conversation is deleted across folders.

dryRun.description: When true, preview which messages would be deleted (per folder) without deleting anything. Recommended before a real run.

messageId.description: RFC 5322 Message-ID of any message in the thread (e.g. `<abc@example.com>`); the whole reply chain is resolved from it.

permanent.description: When false (default), soft-delete the thread to Trash (recoverable). When true, permanently expunge every message — irreversible.

name: delete_thread
